1309-5289-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
1309-5289-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Graaz, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Salvager of Secrets token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1981-2415-7286-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Defiant Salvager's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

280-950-2645-3430.description:
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{B}{B}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Golgari Rot Farm
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Fatestitcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1339-4247-7920.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-4247-7920.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Tresserhorn's Lord triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

4381-4659-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4381-4659-4694-7306.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Repeat from step 1.

requires.n: Land that adds at least two mana

1682-2348-4019--85--172.description:
Play the land that taps for multiple mana.
That land enters as a creature due to Nature's Revolt, triggering Vigean Graftmage's Graft ability, allowing you to move a +1/+1 counter from Vigean Graftmage to that land.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding at least two mana.
Dictate of Karametra triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping the land creature.
Repeat.
1682-2348-4019--85--172.notes:
Note that either the land or the additional mana source must add blue mana.

If the land adds at least {2}{U}, the additional mana source is not necessary.

You may wait a turn after playing the land instead of using the haste enabler.

1308-2097-5660-6462-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

380-1916.description:
Cast Changeling Titan by paying its mana cost.
When Changeling Titan enters, its champion ability and Miirym trigger.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a token copy of Changeling Titan.
When the Changeling Titan token enters, its champion ability triggers, exiling the nontoken Changeling Titan until the token Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Changeling Titan trigger from step 2, exiling the token Changeling Titan.
The token Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Changeling Titan from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

339-677-6974-7730.manaNeeded: {3} if Ashling's Command is in your hand
339-677-6974-7730.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
If Ashling's Command is in your graveyard, activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Ashling's Command from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. Otherwise, cast Ashling's Command by paying {3}{U}{R}.
Resolve Ashling's Command, creating a token copy of Jegantha and choosing any of its remaining modes.
Put the tapped Jegantha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat using the Jegantha token.

3918-4131-4851.notes: Once you have extra mana, Basalt Monolith's ability can be used instead to add mana.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6972-7607.easyPrerequisites: There are at least one land card in all graveyards
2438-6972-7607.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Centaur Vinecrasher.
When Centaur Vinecrasher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7325.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it and that has base toughness 2 or greater.
3967-6972-7325.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nontoken creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature enters, Mighty Mutanimals triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

437-509-3094-4131-5776.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
437-509-3094-4131-5776.description:
Cast Idris either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1}{U}{R} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Idris enters the battlefield, its imprint ability triggers, targeting Sphinx's Disciple.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Idris' trigger, targeting Basalt Monolith.
Resolve both Idris triggers, exiling Basalt Monolith and Sphinx's Disciple.
During your next turn, activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2872-4068-5921-5970.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2872-4068-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Clever Conjurer.
Activate one of the Clever Conjurer tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Clever Conjurer token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

719-5147-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
719-5147-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

5571-6797-7046--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 2.

4766-5256-6990.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Michelangelo.
When Michelangelo dies, it and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Michelangelo trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Michelangelo from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

620-3532-4985-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
620-3532-4985-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Yotian Dissident.
Repeat.

1978-3263-6410.notablePrerequisites: You have max speed. You control at least three Goblins.
1978-3263-6410.description:
Activate Howlsquad Heavy by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Howlsquad Heavy.
Repeat

856-1379-2511-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2232-3668-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control six or more lands.
2232-3668-6749.description:
Cast Flesh Duplicate by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Flesh Duplicate enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from the battlefield to your hand.
When Anticausal Vestige leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Flesh Duplicate from the battlefield to your hand.
When Flesh Duplicate leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Flesh Duplicate from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3305-3817.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing Body Launderer to connive.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat.

requires.n: Artifact / Creature with "{T}: Add Mana" that can tap upon ETB (Mana Rock)

1170-5078-6766--30.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate the mana-producing artifact or creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking the mana-producing artifact or creature.
Repeat.

3951-4094-4452-5703.easyPrerequisites:
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
3951-4094-4452-5703.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

224-3478-6628.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping PuPu UFO.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

requires.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blcoked and killed by an opponent

969-3259--95.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and the creature with mobilize as attackers, triggering the creature with mobilize, creating at least one 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Warrior token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
969-3259--95.notes: If you choose a creature with mobilize 2 or higher, this combo makes extra Warrior tokens each loop.

856-1808-4050-4231.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, adding one mana of any color.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Eloise's second ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

372-961-2239.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Against All Odds exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-961-2239.description:
Cast Against All Odds by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Ardent Elementalist and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Ardent Elementalist trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Against All Odds from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Against All Odds.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Ardent Elementalist and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

224-2653-4348-4967.notablePrerequisites: Ley Druid does not have summoning sickness.
224-2653-4348-4967.description:
Activate Thawing Glaciers by paying {1} and tapping it, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm and Nissa.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Ley Druid.
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Thawing Glaciers.
Repeat.

699-1731-3750-5182.notablePrerequisites:
A Forest in your graveyard.
Tanuki Transplanter attached to Erinis.
Erinis and Orcish Lumberjack do not have summoning sickness.
Erinis cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
699-1731-3750-5182.description:
Declare Erinis as an attacker.
Erinis and Tanuki Transplanter each trigger.
Resolve Erinis's trigger, returning a Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Tanuki Transplanter's trigger, adding {G}{G}{G} that is not lost until end of turn.
Deal combat damage with Erinis.
In your postcombat main phase, activate Orcish Lumberjack by tapping it and sacrificing a Forest, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and generating an additional combat phase and main phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase.
Repeat.

809-1657-4419.description:
Sacrifice Murderous Redcap to Fanatical Devotion to regenerate a creature.
Murderous Redcap's persist triggers, returning it to the battlefield.
Murderous Redcap returns to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter which cancel out.
Murderous Redcap triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1032-2178-3500.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents attached to the same creature.
The creature does not have summoning sickness.
1032-2178-3500.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any opponent's creature and causing you to gain 1 life.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat.

1819-3244-5229.description:
Cast Morality Shift by paying {5}{B}{B}, exchanging your graveyard and library.
Syr Konrad triggers once for each creature card that left your graveyard and once for each creature card put into your graveyard; Ulamog also triggers.
Resolve Ulamog's trigger, shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Syr Konrad triggers an additional time for each creature card that left your graveyard.
Resolve all of Syr Konrad's triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent for each one.

32-1702-3212.description:
Activate Jace's zero loyalty ability, putting Temporal Trespass on top of your library.
Pass the turn.
On your next draw step, when you draw Temporal Trespass, reveal it due to Kefnet's ability, making a copy that costs {2} less to cast.
Cast the copy for {6}{U}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn.
